entries.785ee26ddfe91471: This is a single business that produces and sells reduction gears such as strain wave gearing devices under the Harmonic Drive® name, and mechatronics products (actuators and control devices) that are applications of these reduction gears. The company, 17 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 equity-method affiliates make up 20 companies in total, and its products are used in a wide range of applications, including the joints of industrial robots, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, artificial satellites, advanced medical devices and automotive applications. The reportable segments are divided by region of production and sales responsibility into 4 segments: Japan, China, North America and Europe.
